# Tradurs Diablo IV

> A Korean and English Diablo IV item trading community with seasonal rune guides.

## Public pages

- [한국어 거래 목록](https://d4.tradurs.com/ko): Browse Diablo IV item listings.
- [English trade listings](https://d4.tradurs.com/en): Browse items in English.
- [룬어 가이드](https://d4.tradurs.com/ko/knowledge/runewords): Korean runeword reference.
- [Rune recipes](https://d4.tradurs.com/en/knowledge/rune-recipes): English rune recipe reference.

Listings change over time. Account actions require authentication and user intent.
